name: openpencil
description: Create, inspect, preview, and save editable OpenPencil designs with Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Design editable UI on your local OpenPencil canvas
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to the Rust OpenPencil editor. Build and refine vector UI, inspect layout, preview images, and save .op documents. Requires Node.js 22+ and a running local OpenPencil MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Connect to my local OpenPencil editor.
Create a single-page dashboard in OpenPencil.
Inspect and refine the selected OpenPencil frame.
